constraints: Read complete target assembly before rewriting functions larger than roughly 50 instructions.
A green linked DOL is not semantic evidence for a NonMatching source object.
Use fndiff classifications conservatively: SCHEDULE_CANDIDATE is a review queue, not equivalence proof.
Whole-TU promotion requires text, relocations, data/BSS, exception metadata, claims, and a fresh DOL checksum gate.
name: GDL matching analysis toolchain
purpose: Provide the standard target-assembly, diffing, candidate, data, ownership, and final-link workflow for matching work.
usage: configure.py: generate build files, select exact/non-matching/compiler modes, and report project progress.
ninja: build owning objects and run the current full-link/hash gate.
objdiff and the generated objdiff.json: interactively inspect object code, relocations, and data while iterating.
fnasm.py: read target instructions, branches, relocations, frame shape, and function boundaries.
fndiff.py --ops: separate structural opcode gaps from operand/register differences.
fndiff.py --clean and --count: measure current function residuals without pool-name noise.
matchtool.py probe/sweep: test bounded compiler presets or portable source variants in parallel.
lowmatch.py: select semantic/structural reconstruction candidates; nearmiss.py is a separate exact-closure queue.
claimcheck.py: detect emitted sections missing from splits claims.
datadiff.py: verify data-class bytes, pool order, and relocation placement before linking.
doldiff.py: map final DOL differences to sections, symbols, and owning units.
xbmod.py: inspect Xbox PDB module order and names; verify every conclusion against the GameCube target.
